name: wait_for_music_sequence_load

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_WaitForMusicSequenceLoad takes no Script context and does not access the value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_WaitForMusicSequenceLoad returns pending state 4 while background-music sequence load bit 51 is set in D_00388550 and completion state 2 after it clears. All five JP calls immediately follow command 566 load_background_music_sequence; the paired wave-bank load is awaited separately by command 406.
